description: This file defines the IDGeneratorDao class in the OrangeHRM project, which handles database operations related to generating unique IDs for different entities. It includes methods to retrieve the current ID and update the next ID for a given entity class, utilizing Doctrine's query builder and entity metadata.

classes.name: IDGeneratorDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for generating and managing unique identifiers for entities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getCurrentID
methods.description: Retrieves the current last ID for the specified entity class from the database.

methods.name: updateNextId
methods.description: Updates the last ID for the specified entity class in the database.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Private helper method that retrieves the database table name associated with a given entity class.
